people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.
translations.bsb: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.
translations.kjv: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.
translations.asv: And if ye are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, that is to come.
